description.ncbi_summary: This gene encodes a member of the alpha-actin binding protein gene family. The encoded protein is primarily expressed in skeletal muscle and functions as a structural component of sarcomeric Z line. This protein is involved in crosslinking actin containing thin filaments. An allelic polymorphism in this gene results in both coding and non-coding variants; the reference genome represents the coding allele. The non-functional allele of this gene is associated with elite athlete status. [provided by RefSeq, Apr 2024].

uniprot_function.text: F-actin cross-linking protein which is thought to anchor actin to a variety of intracellular structures. This is a bundling protein.
